workflow.name: legal_review
workflow.title: Legal and compliance review
workflow.description: Identify legal, privacy, policy, licensing, and claims risks; distinguish blockers from questions for qualified counsel.

phases.title: Issue spotting
phases.purpose: Map data flows, jurisdictions, audiences, commercial claims, third-party terms, intellectual-property inputs, regulated activities, and contractual dependencies. Identify which facts are known and which must be confirmed; do not impersonate qualified legal advice.

phases.title: Risk disposition
phases.purpose: Classify each supported concern by severity, trigger, impacted promise, evidence, mitigation, owner, and release disposition. Emit a legal_flag artifact for every unresolved blocker; uncertainty alone is not a blocker unless its consequence and required decision are named.
